definition_en: control that regulates generator output voltage
definition_es: control que regula el voltaje de salida del generador
example_en: Check the automatic voltage regulator when output voltage is unstable.

definition_en: control that regulates prime-mover speed and therefore generator frequency
definition_es: control que regula la velocidad del motor primario y por tanto la frecuencia
example_en: Check the governor when frequency is unstable.

definition_en: device that transfers a load between power sources
definition_es: dispositivo que transfiere una carga entre fuentes de energía
example_en: Test the transfer switch during generator-system maintenance.

definition_en: order in which three-phase voltages reach their corresponding phase positions
definition_es: orden de las fases de un sistema trifásico
example_en: Confirm phase sequence before paralleling or starting equipment.

definition_en: operation of generating sources connected to a common electrical system
definition_es: operación de fuentes de generación conectadas a un sistema común
example_en: Verify required conditions before parallel operation.

definition_en: renewable generating system that converts solar energy to electrical energy
definition_es: sistema renovable que convierte energía solar en energía eléctrica
example_en: Isolate the photovoltaic system before maintenance as required.

definition_en: system that stores energy for later electrical use
definition_es: sistema que almacena energía para uso eléctrico posterior
example_en: Verify the energy storage system is isolated before service.

definition_en: electrochemical generating source identified in the RSOS renewable-energy scope
definition_es: fuente electroquímica de generación identificada en el alcance renovable del RSOS
example_en: A fuel cell is one type of renewable-energy generating system listed in the RSOS.

definition_en: partial electrical discharge occurring around high-voltage conductors or equipment
definition_es: descarga eléctrica parcial alrededor de conductores o equipos de alta tensión
example_en: Corona discharge is a hazard associated with high-voltage systems.

definition_en: test that injects a known current to verify protection or measurement operation
definition_es: prueba que inyecta corriente conocida para verificar protección o medición
example_en: Use current injection as required by the commissioning procedure.

definition_en: arrangement that prevents unsafe or incompatible equipment operations
definition_es: arreglo que impide operaciones inseguras o incompatibles
example_en: Verify interlocking during commissioning tests.

definition_en: winding connected to the input/source side of a transformer
definition_es: devanado conectado al lado de entrada de un transformador
example_en: Verify the primary connections before energization.

definition_en: winding connected to the output/load side of a transformer
definition_es: devanado conectado al lado de salida del transformador
example_en: Measure the secondary voltage after commissioning.

definition_en: ratio between transformer winding turns that relates primary and secondary voltage
definition_es: relación entre vueltas de devanados que relaciona voltajes primario y secundario
example_en: Compare the turn-ratio test with the expected value.

definition_en: test used to confirm transformer or circuit polarity relationships
definition_es: prueba usada para confirmar relaciones de polaridad
example_en: Perform the polarity test according to the procedure.

definition_en: three-phase winding connection with one end of each phase joined at a common point
definition_es: conexión trifásica con un extremo de cada fase unido a un punto común
example_en: The transformer uses a wye connection on the secondary.

definition_en: three-phase winding connection in which phases form a closed loop
definition_es: conexión trifásica en la que las fases forman un circuito cerrado
example_en: Confirm the delta connection before testing.

definition_en: three-phase transformer connection using two transformer units to supply a reduced-capacity three-phase bank
definition_es: conexión trifásica con dos transformadores para un banco de capacidad reducida
example_en: Open-delta is listed among three-phase transformer configurations.

definition_en: fitting used to join sections of conduit
definition_es: accesorio usado para unir secciones de conduit
example_en: Tighten the loose conduit coupling.

definition_en: raceway component that accommodates movement from expansion or structural movement
definition_es: componente de canalización que permite movimiento por expansión o estructura
example_en: Inspect the expansion joint during raceway maintenance.

definition_en: connection joining two or more conductors
definition_es: conexión que une dos o más conductores
example_en: Verify the splice is made according to the applicable requirements.

definition_en: heat-shrinkable material used for insulation or protection of electrical connections
definition_es: material termocontráctil usado para aislamiento o protección
example_en: Apply heat shrink to the conductor connection as specified.

definition_en: housing that protects electrical equipment and persons from environmental or electrical hazards
definition_es: gabinete que protege equipos y personas de condiciones ambientales o eléctricas
example_en: Select the enclosure for the environmental condition.

definition_en: contact device installed at an outlet for connection of a plug
definition_es: dispositivo de contacto instalado para conectar una clavija
example_en: Test the receptacle after maintenance.

definition_en: complete lighting unit including lamp/light source and supporting electrical parts
definition_es: unidad completa de iluminación con fuente de luz y componentes eléctricos
example_en: Verify the luminaire operates after repair.

definition_en: temperature-sensing control used to regulate heating or HVAC operation
definition_es: control sensible a temperatura usado para regular calefacción o HVAC
example_en: Check the thermostat signal during HVAC troubleshooting.

definition_en: switch that changes electrical state based on pressure
definition_es: switch que cambia de estado según la presión
example_en: Verify the pressure switch during HVAC diagnosis.

definition_en: switch that changes electrical state based on fluid or air flow
definition_es: switch que cambia de estado según flujo de fluido o aire
example_en: Check the flow switch if the HVAC interlock is not satisfied.

definition_en: protective/control switch that operates at a defined temperature limit
definition_es: switch de protección/control que actúa a un límite de temperatura
example_en: Test the temperature limit switch in the heating control circuit.

definition_en: electric heating applied along piping or equipment to maintain temperature or prevent freezing
definition_es: calefacción eléctrica aplicada a tubería/equipo para mantener temperatura o evitar congelación
example_en: Inspect the heat tracing circuit and controls.

definition_en: self-contained heater used to heat a space or area
definition_es: calefactor autónomo usado para calentar un espacio
example_en: Verify the forced-air unit heater controls.

definition_en: battery assembly used to provide backup power
definition_es: conjunto de baterías usado para proporcionar energía de respaldo
example_en: Test the emergency-lighting battery pack.

definition_en: alternate power available when normal power is unavailable
definition_es: fuente alternativa disponible cuando falla la alimentación normal
example_en: Verify the emergency lighting on standby power.

definition_en: instrument used to measure illumination level
definition_es: instrumento usado para medir nivel de iluminación
example_en: Use a light intensity meter during emergency-lighting testing.

definition_en: method used to reduce corrosion by controlling electrochemical potential
definition_es: método para reducir corrosión controlando el potencial electroquímico
example_en: Test the cathodic-protection system after repair.

definition_en: anode intentionally consumed to protect another metal structure from corrosion
definition_es: ánodo que se consume para proteger otra estructura metálica de corrosión
example_en: Inspect the sacrificial anode system.

definition_en: designated point used for measurements or monitoring in a cathodic-protection system
definition_es: punto designado usado para mediciones o monitoreo en protección catódica
example_en: Measure the system at the remote reference point.

definition_en: temporary conductor used to maintain electrical continuity during repair
definition_es: conductor temporal usado para mantener continuidad durante una reparación
example_en: Install the bypass jumper to maintain cathodic protection continuity.

definition_en: electrically operated switching device commonly used to control motors or loads
definition_es: dispositivo de maniobra operado eléctricamente usado para controlar motores o cargas
example_en: Inspect the contactor contacts in the motor starter.

definition_en: secondary contact used for control, indication or interlocking
definition_es: contacto secundario usado para control, indicación o enclavamiento
example_en: Use the auxiliary contact in the seal-in circuit.

definition_en: control circuit arrangement that keeps a starter energized after a momentary start command
definition_es: arreglo de control que mantiene energizado un starter después de una orden momentánea
example_en: Trace the seal-in circuit on the schematic.

definition_en: starter that reduces applied voltage or starting current during acceleration
definition_es: starter que reduce voltaje aplicado o corriente durante el arranque
example_en: Test the reduced-voltage starter sequence.

definition_en: intermediate direct-current link inside many AC drives
definition_es: enlace de corriente directa intermedio dentro de muchos drives CA
example_en: Verify the DC bus condition according to the drive procedure.

definition_en: feedback device that provides position or speed information
definition_es: dispositivo de realimentación que proporciona posición o velocidad
example_en: Check the encoder feedback when drive speed is unstable.

definition_en: drive parameter defining how quickly speed increases toward a command
definition_es: parámetro del drive que define qué tan rápido aumenta la velocidad
example_en: Verify the acceleration time after programming changes.
